name: Suspicious Network Activity
description: The Suspicious Network Activity dashboard shows suspicious activity on networks. It shows suspicious blocked source-destination pairs, suspicious traffic, trends for blocked activity and traffic, and geo locations for suspicious blocked destinations and traffic.
title: Suspicious Network Activity

panels.title: Suspicious Blocked Destinations by Location

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=PDET/CIS/AWS/Vanta/Flow  
| json "firewall_name", "availability_zone", "event" as cloud.instance.name, cloud.availability_zone, event nodrop
| json field=event "event_type", "src_ip", "src_port", "dest_ip", "dest_port", "proto", "alert" as event.type, server.ip, server.port, client.ip, client.port, network.protocol, alert nodrop
| where event.type="alert"
| json field=alert "severity", "signature", "action", "category" as risk.static_level, signature, event.outcome, category nodrop

| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client.ip

// filters
| where if ("{{server.ip}}" = "*", true, server.ip matches "{{server.ip}}") AND if ("{{client.ip}}" = "*", true, client.ip matches "{{client.ip}}") AND if ("{{cloud.availability_zone}}" = "*", true, cloud.availability_zone matches "{{cloud.availability_zone}}") AND if ("{{cloud.instance.name}}" = "*", true, cloud.instance.name matches "{{cloud.instance.name}}") AND if ("{{network.protocol}}" = "*", true, network.protocol matches "{{network.protocol}}")

// z-score calculation
| timeslice 3h
| if(event.outcome="blocked",1,0) as Blocked_count
| if(event.outcome="allowed",1,0) as Allowed_count
|sum(Blocked_count) as blocked, sum(Allowed_count) as allowed by _timeslice, server.ip, client.ip, latitude, longitude, country_code
| (blocked + allowed) as requests
| if(requests > 0, blocked/requests, 0) as blocked_pct
| blocked_pct as eventCount
| sort + _timeslice

| rollingstd eventCount as eventCount_std by server.ip, client.ip, latitude, longitude, country_code
| smooth eventCount as eventCount_mean by server.ip, client.ip, latitude, longitude, country_code
| eventCount_std + 0.1 as eventCount_std
| (eventCount - eventCount_mean) / eventCount_std as zscore
| sort + _timeslice

| max(zscore) as max_zscore by server.ip, client.ip, latitude, longitude, country_code
| round(max_zscore, 2) as max_zscore 
| where max_zscore > "{{risk.calculated_level}}"
| sort - max_zscore

| count as event_location by latitude, longitude
| sort by event_location

panels.description: Shows the geo-locations of WAF hits.
